thesis: APPN is up about 38% in 21 days into a tech-weak tape, with the catalyst (the 11-05 earnings gap) already priced and the average analyst target about equal to price. Reward/risk is only 1.54 from a high-ATR (5.6% of price) setup, with first resistance at the 56.38 high just 4.9% away. Pre-market is already 8.6% over SMA20, so a retest of the 49-50 area is the likelier path than a clean breakout. Operating cash outflow is unresolved, short interest of 11.7% makes moves violent both ways, and the macro regime (QQQ below its 50-day, 10-year yield near 5.05% at the 89th percentile) pressures long-duration software multiples.
